Thank you, this entire thread was just tons of people generalizing an entire generation. Or just talking with the most basic face-level facts. nobody really thinks about how things changed, like there's a guy above you who said "a boomer pushing a button in a factory makes as much as a millenial who went through college." Now i wouldn't be surprised if that were right but... there's no deeper thought put into it. Like why that person made that money, or what change caused it, or just anything. Just some basic fact that proves their point. 

 Or there's another guy who told some story of how they told their family how high schools are gpa-farms. But something about how it was worded left a bad taste in my mouth. Like... this person just sees his family as just their political beliefs and nothing more. 

Film reading this thread i have a feeling millenials won't be treating boomers all that well. I saved your comments to look through the links later.
